Count.description: Number of VM instances to create (count), for example 1.

Cpu.description: vCPU count per VM, for example 2 for two vCPUs; not millicores or a utilization ratio.

Mem.description: Memory per VM in bytes (B). Example: 4 GiB = 4294967296 B; pass 4294967296. Forwarded unchanged to the provider.

DiskSize.description: Root disk capacity per VM in bytes (B). Example: 20 GiB = 21474836480 B; pass 21474836480. Forwarded unchanged to the provider.
